  PROBLEM: The exit-75 rate-limited deferral sets SKIP_PLAN=true, which skips "Validate planning phase label" (lines 1004-1067), so an `ai:blocked` or `ai:clarification` issue is never moved to `ai:planning`.   WHY: `ai:blocked` has no STALL_RECOVERY_ACTIONS entry (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1663-1716), so nothing re-posts `/answer` and the issue stays stuck. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (and did not verify the orchestrate_lib.py claim), gemini rated it unlabeled, and the other reviewers rated it MAJOR. The highest is used, mapped to high.

  WHY: The text misleads operators into thinking recovery is automatic. Severity disagreement: the hardening suggestions were low-risk, and minimax-m3 rated the same text MAJOR.

Keep the test substrings "Planning for issue #5 was deferred" and "post /answer again by hand". Align the README row and the agents.d fragment. About 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
